text: Improved defenses, reaction, or second action.
Named enemy with phase trigger or command aura.
Requires boss actions and objective mechanics.
Designed as the tier capstone; never a simple boss.

A normal encounter uses a budget equal to the number of party members. A hard encounter uses 1.5 times party size. A severe encounter uses twice party size. Attrition, cargo, missing resources, incompatible alignment, and time pressure can each raise effective difficulty by one step.
The creature has dependence on a named substance. Without a maintenance dose after a long rest, it gains Withdrawal.
Take damage equal to proficiency bonus at the end of each turn. An action and Medicine check or magical healing ends it.
Cannot see; automatically fails sight checks; attacks have disadvantage and attacks against it have advantage.
Take fire damage at end of turn. An action, immersion, or successful Dexterity save ends it.
Cannot willingly harm the charmer; charmer has advantage on social checks against it.
Healing is reduced, corruption-sensitive effects worsen, and long rests may shift behavior or form until cleansed.
Choose either action or movement on the turn, not both; no bonus action.
Cannot hear and fails hearing checks; verbal coordination may fail.
Use the six-level exhaustion track; effects are cumulative and level 6 is death.
Disadvantage while source is visible and cannot willingly move closer.
Speed 0; ends if grappler is incapacitated or reach is broken.
Disadvantage on precise Dexterity and Intelligence checks; advantage on one save against fear. Stacks worsen into Dazed and Unconscious.
Cannot be seen normally; attacks against it have disadvantage and its attacks have advantage until location is revealed.
A named creature or faction can track, target, or trigger abilities against the marked creature.
Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, adjacent hits are critical.
Incapacitated stone-like state; resistance to damage, immunity to poison/disease, weight ×10.
Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.
Crawl or stand; melee attackers within 5 ft. have advantage; ranged attackers have disadvantage.
Maximum RP reduced and spell failure risk increases until a long rest or treatment.
Speed 0; attacks against have advantage, own attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage.
Cannot use verbal components, command words, Chants, or audible coordination.
Cannot react, loses Guard, and the next forced movement gains +5 ft. Ends at start of next turn.
Incapacitated, cannot move, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, attacks against have advantage.
Incapacitated, unaware, drops held items, falls Prone, adjacent hits are critical.
Track exposure from 0-6. At thresholds, distinctions, memories, loyalties, and eventually identity begin to erode.
Disadvantage on ability checks and RP recovery; severity depends on substance and duration of dependence.
Each Wound imposes -1 Constitution saves and reduces Hit Dice recovery; three Wounds is Critical.
